findings.title: Require executed coverage for every requested regression selector
findings.body: The collection oracle verifies that each node matches any required selector, but never that every selector has an executed node. The independently created complete Git fixture passes with transaction_interfaces entirely absent from migrations+transaction_interfaces, and DB shadow isolation entirely absent from unit+DB shadow isolation. Command strings, collection raw/hash/counts, JUnit equality and freshness all remain valid. This contradicts the closure contract forbidding omitted selectors/empty substitutes and permits a fresh integrated regression to claim a required suite it did not execute.
findings.required_change: Require every required selector to have at least one matching collected/executed node. Populate the valid fixture with all requested selectors and add hash-correct collection/JUnit omission negatives that pass freshness and fail the selector-coverage oracle.

findings.title: Enforce integer exit-code type consistently
findings.body: The guard rejects booleans but accepts JSON 0.0 because Python float zero compares equal to integer zero. The same comparison appears in collection binding. The contract specifies integer zero; the independent probe confirms 0.0 is accepted past the other execution evidence guards. This does not claim a failed exit was accepted.
findings.required_change: Use an exact integer type check for execution and collection exit codes and retain negative tests for floating-point zero.
